method.caption: 20-clone pixel-minus-observer relief variance mapped through the nominal skyline Jacobian and summed over bundle-defined near-horizon Sun/Earth target-hours.
method.candidate: nominal near-field 5 m skyline-controlling ray samples, grouped by containing PGDA 78 pixel
method.dispersion: population variance of paired controlling-pixel minus observer-ground relief across deterministic PGDA 78 clones 1-20; absolute pixel variance is retained as a diagnostic
method.jacobian: horizon variance = clone relative-height variance * (degrees(cos(theta)^2 / distance))^2
method.score: sum of horizon variance times sample step over Sun and Earth samples with |nominal margin| below derived.coverage.critical_threshold_deg
method.coverage: far-field controllers have no PGDA 78 clone support and are excluded; any candidate beyond skyline.max_range_m scores exactly zero
method.limitation: piecewise nominal-controller sensitivity only; controller switching and decision-flip precision/recall are deferred to the flip-forecast PILOT
